dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Sedan chair bearers must go to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs to apply for a Sedan Chair Permit. After passing the written and road tests, you are free to carry people around.

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Furthermore, sedan chairs must apply for a wooden plate at the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs before they can legally be used on the road. Don't forget to do this!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I applied for a wooden plate last year for my new sedan chair and still haven't received it. My sedan chair is gathering dust... When will my wooden plate be approved?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Please be patient. You will be notified later when it is approved.
